title: metadata designer copy: the designer table's 「此环境 / 本环境」 / "this environment" strings, the same rule objectui#12956 applied to the locale packs (cloud#3002 ruling A)
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) from the objectui#12956 dev's out-of-scope findings (os-dev-report `6249167086`), verified on objectui `origin/main` `b5153f4`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

**Ruling it follows:** objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A (the maintainer, 2026-10-18), as objectui#12956 applied it to the locale packs: inside the running system, 「此环境 / 本环境」 / "this environment" names the system the user is in (「本系统」 / "this system", or dropped). objectui#12956's Scope named the locale packs only, so the metadata designer's own string table was not touched.

## Where (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, line numbers on `b5153f4`)
- `engine.packages.description` (en :2270, zh :5695): "installed in this environment" / 「此环境中安装的软件包」.
- `engine.packages.noCapability` (en :2330, zh :5750): "manage packages in this environment" / 「在此环境管理软件包」.
- `engine.packages.detail.adoptConfirm` (en :2393, zh :5839): "metadata in this environment" / 「本环境中所有……元数据」.
- `perm.badge.custom` (zh :5879): 「本环境自定义」.
- Four permission-set clone / lock strings (en :2564–:2592, zh :5976–:5993): "authored in this environment" / 「本环境中创作的」.

## The judgment triage owes
Some of these strings use "environment" in a technical sense: the environment-scope overlay (`allowEnvironmentOverlay`), the layer where a customized permission set lives as opposed to the packaged base. That may be the platform's own term rather than the cloud noun. Triage decides, per string, which are the "system you are in" sense (rewrite under the ruling) and which name the overlay layer (keep, or name it differently). The designer table also feeds `check:i18n-designer-parity`, so en and zh move together.

## Also noted (not this card's scope)
- `cloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.seeded` (cloud home) still says 环境时区, while objectui#12956 renames the in-system prompt to 系统时区: one setting, two names across the cloud and in-system surfaces.
- zh `marketplace.*` (`accessDenied.description` 本环境中, `detail.reseedQueued` / `sampleDataKernelUnavailable` 该环境, install / update `dialogDescCurrent` / `deployTimeout` 当前环境): install-target copy, plausibly the cloud noun's own use. Listed for completeness only.

## Done when
Each designer-table string triage rules "the system you are in" reads without the cloud noun in en and zh; the overlay-sense strings are kept or renamed per triage's call; `check:i18n-designer-parity` stays green.
